content.text:
Implemented assigned API/UI scope:

- Local opt-in session bootstrap, server identity, owner scoping and mutation Origin checks.
- Task/project APIs, bounded SSE replay with reauthorization, source/artifact endpoints and protected configuration status.
- Workspace composer and task detail with real plan, runs, events, sources, verification limitations, cancellation and report downloads.
- Preserved health UI; worker/checkpointer correctly report unobserved.
- Sent local setup instructions and limitations to core for `docs/phase-3.md`.

Source-reviewed API/repository and worker/runtime/verification signatures. No tests, builds, import checks, browser runs, providers, migrations or Git publication performed.

Limits: local authentication uses one API process and restart-expiring sessions; manual resume remains unavailable; live readiness and execution remain unqualified.
